stories.title: Canada's Carney reports progress in trade talks with Trump days before US midterms
stories.summary: Canadian PM Mark Carney said he and Donald Trump discussed a potential trade deal as Ottawa races to double its non-US exports. A breakthrough would ease the tariff war that has strained both economies.

stories.title: Israeli officials say election results will stand despite Netanyahu's 'stolen vote' claims
stories.summary: Election officials said last week's Knesset vote would not be overturned even if foreign-interference claims are proven, undercutting Netanyahu's effort to delegitimize a result that left his bloc short of a majority. Israel now faces weeks of coalition uncertainty.

stories.title: Iran says it can reopen the Strait of Hormuz within two days if US meets demands
stories.summary: Tehran shortened its proposed timeline to reopen the strait and resume nuclear talks from a week to two days, conditional on Washington lifting sanctions and its naval blockade. The Qatari-mediated offer could ease an energy crisis tied to the world's most important oil chokepoint.

stories.title: Anthropic posts $17B quarterly revenue but keeps losing money in updated IPO filing
stories.summary: Anthropic's amended S-1 showed $17B in quarterly revenue (up roughly 12x year-over-year) and $895B in committed AI-computing spend, alongside a large net loss. The filing advances its blockbuster IPO while underscoring the enormous cost of frontier AI.

stories.title: ZKH and Intel launch AI model that verifies industrial parts at delivery
stories.summary: LingLong Insight 1.0 pairs ZKH's product database with Intel edge hardware to check industrial supplies against purchase records as they arrive. The multimodal system cuts manual inspection and runs locally to reduce cloud dependence.

stories.title: Japanese web firm GMO apologizes after cyberattack exposed customer data
stories.summary: GMO Internet Group's CEO bowed in apology in Tokyo over breaches that leaked customer information and caused unauthorized transactions affecting dozens of firms. The incident adds to a recent wave of high-profile cyberattacks on Japanese tech companies.

stories.title: Browns' run defense, exposed by the Steelers, is becoming a season-long problem
stories.summary: Cleveland allowed 200 rushing yards and three scores on 33 carries in Pittsburgh, its fifth game surrendering over 125 yards on the ground. With the two worst outings coming in consecutive weeks, the leaky front threatens to unravel a defense that carried the team.

stories.title: Browns' loss to Pittsburgh was the reality check their five wins disguised
stories.summary: Cleveland's 27-6 defeat exposed problems its five late-game wins had masked, including being outscored by 52 points in first quarters this season. With the division lead at stake, the Browns also learned rival QB Lamar Jackson is headed for surgery.

stories.title: Browns' ground game stalls again, and the Steelers showed why it matters
stories.summary: Cleveland managed just 34 rushing yards on 15 carries (2.3 yards per attempt) in the 27-6 loss, letting Pittsburgh tee off for eight sacks. The one-dimensional offense magnified every other weakness and kept the defense on the field.

stories.title: 'Our backs are against the wall': Ohio State's postseason hopes shaken by USC loss
stories.summary: The 30-18 loss at USC dropped Ohio State to 6-2 and No. 11, its first November with two losses since 2011 and first time outside the top 10 in five years. A third defeat would likely end its College Football Playoff hopes, leaving little margin with four games left.

stories.title: Ohio State opens as the test Oregon needs in a suddenly vulnerable Buckeyes team
stories.summary: After back-to-back losses, Ohio State (6-2) hosts Oregon on Nov. 7 in a matchup of two teams whose playoff paths have narrowed. The preview breaks down how a young Buckeyes offense led by freshman QB Luke Fahey matches up against the Ducks.

stories.title: Leclerc addresses potential F1 race absence ahead of first child's birth
stories.summary: The Ferrari driver opened up about possibly missing a race as he and his partner await their first child. It is a rare mid-season personal consideration for a front-running driver with implications for the team's championship chase.

stories.title: Norris issues blunt warning: McLaren has 'one of the hardest cars I've ever had to drive'
stories.summary: Lando Norris's candid assessment signals renewed concern about McLaren's competitiveness as the season winds down. The remark puts pressure on the team to fix drivability issues before the remaining rounds.

stories.title: Lewis Hamilton says Kimi Antonelli 'deserves to be the champion'
stories.summary: After Antonelli sealed the 2026 title in Mexico as F1's youngest-ever champion, Hamilton publicly backed the new world champion. The endorsement comes amid Hamilton's own frustration with teammate Leclerc after a first-lap clash cost Ferrari a likely win.

stories.title: VP Vance and Ohio candidates make final push as Columbus hosts closing rallies
stories.summary: Vice President JD Vance returned to Ohio for rallies backing Jon Husted and Vivek Ramaswamy, while Democrats Amy Acton and Sherrod Brown planned a Monday-night event in Columbus. The blitz caps a battleground-state finish to Tuesday's midterm elections.

stories.title: Indian restaurants boom across Columbus, Gahanna and Westerville
stories.summary: A new upscale Indian eatery replaced a former sports bar on Polaris Parkway, a Reynoldsburg Indian-Nepali spot expanded into Gahanna, and downtown Columbus quickly filled a departing restaurant's space. The openings reflect a surge in the region's Indian dining scene.
